input.quote: The Servicer will indemnify the Issuer, the Owner Trustee and the Indenture Trustee (including in its capacity as Note Paying Agent), and their officers, directors, employees and agents (each, an "Indemnified Person") for all fees, expenses, losses, claims, actions, suits, damages and liabilities (including reasonable legal fees and expenses) resulting from the Servicer's (including in its capacity as Custodian) willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence in performing its obligations under the Transaction Documents
input.rationale: Section 6.3 contains a Servicer/Marketing Agent (vendor-side) indemnity in our favour, but it is limited to willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence and carries no third-party intellectual-property infringement cover, no procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and no super-cap construct. Under the detection guidance a vendor indemnity that excludes IP infringement is a deviation, so the fallback is not met on a material term. The existing claim procedure in Section 6.3(b) (prompt notice, Servicer's right to assume the defense) is retained untouched, as is our own defend-title covenant in Section 9.2, which we do not flag. We therefore target the fallback only, inserting a single new Section 6.3(e) carrying the IP indemnity, the modification/combination/specification exclusions, the procure-modify-replace and refund remedies and a three times annual Servicing Fee cap expressed so that it applies solely to the new indemnity and does not cut back our existing uncapped Section 6.3(a) rights.

proposal.summary: Add a Servicer IP infringement indemnity (with customary exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fee super-cap) as new Section 6.3(e).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6.3 gives us a Servicer/Marketing Agent indemnity only for willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence, with no cover for third-party intellectual property claims arising from the systems and software the Servicer uses. We have added our fallback IP indemnity as a new Section 6.3(e), with the usual Customer modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace and refund remedies, and a three times annual Servicing Fee super-cap.

ops.text: (e) Intellectual Property Indemnity. The Servicer will indemnify the Indemnified Persons for any third-party claim that the systems, software or other materials used by the Servicer in performing its obligations under the Transaction Documents infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, except to the extent the claim results from modifications, combinations or specifications made or supplied by an Indemnified Person. In that event, the Servicer will procure the right to continue such use, or modify or replace the affected item, and if none of those remedies is available on commercially reasonable terms, will refund the Servicing Fees paid for the affected item. The Servicer's aggregate liability under this Section 6.3(e) will not exceed three times the aggregate Servicing Fees paid to the Servicer during the twelve months preceding the claim.

mappings.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
